# OPNsense Firewall Filter API Reference

Generated from live requests executed against the target OPNsense instance using `hack/opnsense-curl.sh` and credentials loaded from `.env.local`. All session-created rules were deleted and cleanup was verified in H38.

## 1. Endpoint Summary Table

| Method | Path | Purpose | Apply needed after? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/getRule | Return empty-rule model schema when UUID is omitted | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/getRule/{uuid} | Return one rule model by UUID; non-existent UUID returned [] | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/searchRule | Search and paginate stored rules | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/addRule | Create a rule in config | Yes |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/setRule/{uuid} | Partially update a rule by UUID | Yes |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/toggleRule/{uuid}/{0\|1} | Disable or enable a rule | Yes |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/delRule/{uuid} | Delete a rule by UUID | Yes |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/apply | Apply pending config to running firewall rules | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/apply/{revision} | Apply pending config with savepoint revision argument | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/savepoint | Create rollback revision token | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/cancelRollback/{revision} | Cancel pending rollback timer | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/getInterfaceList | List valid floating/group/interface targets | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/listCategories | List category values | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/listNetworkSelectOptions | List source/destination network options and aliases | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/listPortSelectOptions | List port aliases and well-known ports | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/flushInspectCache | Flush inspect/statistics cache | No |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/moveRuleBefore/{selected}/{target} | Reorder one rule before another | Yes |
| POST | /api/firewall/filter/toggleRuleLog/{uuid}/{0\|1} | Toggle logging on a rule (GET returned Invalid request method here) | Yes |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/downloadRules | Export rules as CSV | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/filter/get | Return full filter model tree | No |
| GET | /api/firewall/alias/searchItem | Supporting alias lookup for source_net tests | No |

## 2. Full Rule Model Schema

Top-level request note: `addRule` and `setRule` expected a top-level `rule` object. Individual fields below were observed as optional because `getRule` supplies defaults and `setRule` accepted partial payloads.

| Field | Type | Allowed values | Default | Required? | Observed notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | bool-string | 0, 1 | 1 | No |  |
| statetype | select | keep, sloppy, modulate, synproxy, none | keep | No |  |
| state-policy | select | , if-bound, floating |  | No |  |
| sequence | string | free-form string | 200 | No | Default from blank getRule was 200; omitted sequence auto-assigned 300 in B5; duplicate 200 accepted in F32. |
| sort_order | string | free-form string |  | No |  |
| prio_group | string | free-form string |  | No |  |
| action | select | pass, block, reject | pass | No | Invalid value returned validation error in F25a. |
| quick | bool-string | 0, 1 | 1 | No |  |
| interfacenot | bool-string | 0, 1 | 0 | No |  |
| interface | select | lan, testgroup, opt1, wan |  | No | No selection = floating/group-style rule with prio_group 200000; lan selection produced prio_group 400000 in B7/E20. |
| direction | select | in, out, any | in | No | Invalid value returned validation error in F25b. |
| ipprotocol | select | inet, inet6, inet46 | inet | No |  |
| protocol | select | any, TCP, UDP, TCP/UDP, ICMP, ESP, AH, GRE, IGMP, PIM, OSPF, 3PC, A/N, ARGUS, ARIS, AX.25, BBN-RCC, BNA, BR-SAT-MON, CARP, CBT, CFTP, CHAOS, COMPAQ-PEER, CPHB, CPNX, CRTP, CRUDP, DCCP, DCN, DDP, DDX, DGP, DIVERT, DSR, EGP, EIGRP, EMCON, ENCAP, ETHERIP, FC, GGP, GMTP, HIP, HMP, I-NLSP, IATP, IDPR, IDPR-CMTP, IDRP, IFMP, IGP, IL, IPCOMP, IPCV, IPENCAP, IPIP, IPPC, IPV6, IPV6-ICMP, IPX-IN-IP, IRTP, ISIS, ISO-IP, ISO-TP4, KRYPTOLAN, L2TP, LARP, LEAF-1, LEAF-2, MANET, MERIT-INP, MFE-NSP, MICP, MOBILE, MPLS-IN-IP, MTP, MUX, NARP, NETBLT, NSFNET-IGP, NVP, PFSYNC, PGM, PIPE, PNNI, PRM, PTP, PUP, PVP, QNX, RDP, ROHC, RSVP, RSVP-E2E-IGNORE, RVD, SAT-EXPAK, SAT-MON, SCC-SP, SCPS, SCTP, SDRP, SECURE-VMTP, SHIM6, SKIP, SM, SMP, SNP, SPRITE-RPC, SPS, SRP, ST2, STP, SUN-ND, SWIPE, TCF, TLSP, TP++, TRUNK-1, TRUNK-2, TTP, UDPLITE, UTI, VINES, VISA, VMTP, WB-EXPAK, WB-MON, WESP, WSN, XNET, XNS-IDP, XTP | any | No | Invalid value returned validation error in F25c. |

## 3. Per-Endpoint Documentation

### GET /api/firewall/filter/searchRule

- Description: Searches existing rules and returns bootgrid-style pagination fields plus `rows`.
- Request format: `GET /api/firewall/filter/searchRule?searchPhrase=<phrase>`
- Success response example (Scenario A2, HTTP 200):
```
{"total":1,"rowCount":1,"current":1,"rows":[{"uuid":"a23a7a28-1b43-45ad-b5d7-36731d1c6580","enabled":"1","statetype":"keep","%statetype":"keep state","state-policy":"","sequence":"100","sort_order":"300000.0000100","prio_group":"300000","action":"pass","%action":"Pass","quick":"1","interfacenot":"0","interface":"testgroup","direction":"in","%direction":"In","ipprotocol":"inet","%ipprotocol":"IPv4","protocol":"any","icmptype":"","icmp6type":"","source_net":"any","source_not":"0","source_port":"","destination_net":"any","destination_not":"0","destination_port":"","divert-to":"","gateway":"","replyto":"","disablereplyto":"0","log":"0","allowopts":"0","nosync":"0","nopfsync":"0","statetimeout":"","udp-first":"","udp-multiple":"","udp-single":"","max-src-nodes":"","max-src-states":"","max-src-conn":"","max":"","max-src-conn-rate":"","max-src-conn-rates":"","overload":"","adaptivestart":"","adaptiveend":"","prio":"","set-prio":"","set-prio-low":"","tag":"","tagged":"","tcpflags1":"","tcpflags2":"","tcpflags_any":"0","categories":"","sched":"","tos":"","shaper1":"","shaper2":"","description":"","alias_meta_source_net":[{"value":"any","%value":"any","isAlias":false,"description":""}],"alias_meta_destination_net":[{"value":"any","%value":"any","isAlias":false,"description":""}],"category_colors":[]}]}
```

- Error / alternate responses:

  - Substring matches were case-insensitive in S1.
  - No-match shape was still HTTP 200 with `total:0` and empty `rows`.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/addRule

- Description: Creates a rule and returns a UUID on success.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/addRule with JSON body `{ "rule": { ... } }``
- Success response example (Scenario B3, HTTP 200):
```
{"result":"saved","uuid":"eb3c7d1b-4348-4b93-8a94-1efabf9225d2"}
```
- Error / alternate responses:
  - Scenario F24, HTTP 200
```
{"result":"failed"}
```
  - Scenario F25a, HTTP 200
```
{"result":"failed","validations":{"rule.action":"Option [] not in list."}}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Top-level `rule` wrapper was required: `{}` returned `{"result":"failed"}`.
  - Validation failures still used HTTP 200 and reported details under `validations`.
  - Apply was required before the running ruleset reflected the new rule.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/setRule/{uuid}

- Description: Partially updates an existing rule; omitted fields were preserved in observed tests.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/setRule/<uuid> with JSON body `{ "rule": { ...partial fields... } }``
- Success response example (Scenario E18, HTTP 200):
```
{"result":"saved"}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - E21 proved a sequence-only payload worked and preserved the remaining rule fields.
  - Interface changes recalculated `prio_group` and `sort_order` between floating/group and interface sections.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/toggleRule/{uuid}/{0|1}

- Description: Staged disable/enable toggle for a rule.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/toggleRule/<uuid>/0 or /1`
- Success response example (Scenario E22a, HTTP 200):
```
{"result":"Disabled","changed":true}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Both disable and re-enable used POST and required a follow-up apply.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/delRule/{uuid}

- Description: Deletes a rule from config.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/delRule/<uuid>`
- Success response example (Scenario F27, HTTP 200):
```
{"result":"deleted"}
```
- Error / alternate responses:
  - Scenario F26b, HTTP 200
```
{"result":"not found"}
```
  - Scenario F28, HTTP 200
```
{"result":"not found"}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Delete succeeded immediately in config: a following getRule on the same UUID returned `[]` even before apply (F27).
  - Deleting a missing UUID returned `{"result":"not found"}` with HTTP 200.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/apply

- Description: Applies staged filter changes.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/apply with `{}` body`
- Success response example (Scenario C14, HTTP 200):
```
{"status":"OK\n\n"}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Observed response shape was always `{"status":"OK\n\n"}` whether or not anything was pending (C14, F29).

### POST /api/firewall/filter/apply/{revision}

- Description: Applies staged changes while referencing a savepoint revision.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/apply/<revision>`
- Success response example (Scenario F31, HTTP 200):
```
{"status":"OK\n\n"}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Response matched plain apply in this environment.
  - Using a revision did not produce any observable config rollback in subsequent `searchRule` calls after 65 seconds.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/savepoint

- Description: Returns a rollback revision token plus retention count.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/savepoint with `{}` body`
- Success response example (Scenario F31, HTTP 200):
```
{"status":"ok","retention":"100","revision":"1779720878.49"}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - Observed shape: `{"status":"ok","retention":"100","revision":"..."}`.

### POST /api/firewall/filter/cancelRollback/{revision}

- Description: Cancels a pending rollback timer.
- Request format: `POST /api/firewall/filter/cancelRollback/<revision>`
- Success response example (Scenario S3, HTTP 200):
```
{"status":"\n\n"}
```
- Error / alternate responses:
  - Scenario F31, HTTP 200
```
{"status":""}
```
- Notes / gotchas:
  - The response body was ambiguous: within the 60-second window it returned `{"status":"\n\n"}`; after the window it returned `{"status":""}`.

### GET /api/firewall/filter/getInterfaceList

- Description: Lists floating/group/interface options with counts.
- Request format: `GET /api/firewall/filter/getInterfaceList`

## 5. Managed-Suffix Search Behaviour

- `searchRule` matched managed suffixes by case-insensitive substring, not exact whole-description equality.
- `searchPhrase=default/allow-https` returned `Allow HTTPS [opnsense-operator:default/allow-https]` (G36).
- `searchPhrase=default/rule-a` returned both matching rows when two rules shared the same suffix (G37).
- `searchPhrase=DEFAULT/RULE-A` and `searchPhrase=Default/Allow-Https` still matched (S1), so case differences did not matter in this environment.
- Reliable operator fallback lookup: search by the managed suffix string, then handle 0, 1, or many rows. Do not assume uniqueness unless the suffix itself is unique.

## 6. Apply / Savepoint Behaviour

- `addRule`, `setRule`, `toggleRule`, `delRule`, `moveRuleBefore`, and `toggleRuleLog` all staged config changes and needed a follow-up apply to affect the running ruleset.
- Plain `apply` always returned the same body in this environment: `{"status":"OK\n\n"}`. There was no distinct no-op response when nothing was pending (C14, F29).
- `savepoint` returned `{"status":"ok","retention":"100","revision":"..."}`.
- `cancelRollback/{revision}` returned ambiguous blank-ish status strings (`{"status":"\n\n"}` or `{"status":""}`), not a clear `ok`/`failed` marker.
- No observable rollback was visible through `searchRule` after 65 seconds, regardless of whether the savepoint was taken before or after the create (F31, S2). This suggests the auto-rollback either does not affect the config model exposed by `searchRule` or was not active in this environment.
- Because `searchRule` kept returning the created rule after 65 seconds, client code should not assume savepoint timers remove config rows; verify desired state explicitly if rollback matters.

## 7. Go Client Recommendations

- Treat HTTP status and response body separately. Most validation and not-found conditions still came back as HTTP 200.
- For create/update/delete success, inspect `result` or `status` in the JSON body. `addRule` returned `{"result":"saved","uuid":"..."}`; `setRule` returned `{"result":"saved"}`; `delRule` returned `{"result":"deleted"}`.
- Detect validation errors by checking `result == "failed"` and then decoding the optional `validations` object.
- Detect get-by-UUID not-found as bare JSON array `[]`, not a typed error object.
- Detect delete not-found as `{"result":"not found"}`.
- Always wrap rule payloads inside a top-level `rule` object.
- Rely on explicit field values instead of defaults where correctness matters. Defaults observed here were `action=pass`, `direction=in`, `ipprotocol=inet`, `protocol=any`, and floating/group-style placement when `interface` was omitted.
- Sequence values are not unique. Duplicate `sequence=200` was accepted for two different rules.
- Search is case-insensitive substring matching and can return multiple rows for one managed suffix. Operator fallback lookup should handle 0/1/N matches.
- Omitting `interface` or setting it to an empty string produced floating/group-style rules with `prio_group=200000`; setting `interface=lan` produced interface rules with `prio_group=400000`.
- Partial `setRule` payloads worked. A payload with only `sequence` updated that field and preserved everything else.
- Description length above 255 characters failed validation. Special characters such as `/`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `[`, and `]` were accepted.
- Use POST for `toggleRuleLog` in this environment even though the official docs list GET.
- `apply` returned the same `{"status":"OK\n\n"}` body even when nothing was pending, so do not use the body to detect whether changes existed.
- Wrong credentials produced HTTP 401, body `{"status":401,"message":"Authentication Failed"}`, and curl exit code 22 through the helper script.
